remarks: Both sets read the hexagon '3' inside each module symbol as an 'internal value', 'value' or 'quantity'; per the LEGEND that '3' is the symbol key for the SUNPREME GX290 solar module, so those claims are misbound/trivial in both sets. The whole comparison turns on one truncated value, so the ranking is fragile.
